title: Implement deterministic DX-OS quality gate
description: BR001-R3: replace false-green scripts/check.ps1 with explicit tool preflight, native exit propagation, bounded commands, DXOS.slnx targeting, and evidence outputs.
acceptance_criteria: The Windows-safe gate stops non-zero on every missing required tool or failed command, cannot be overwritten by later success, names all targets, and exposes deterministic staged checks for downstream runtime/test/security tasks.

title: Prove DX-OS Engineering OS runtime spike
description: BR001-R4: integrate stable Elsa NuGet, PostgreSQL, Aspire, API health, Compose, and an executable workflow smoke without Elsa source/project references.
acceptance_criteria: Clean checkout starts via Compose and Aspire and passes executable workflow, database, health, and runtime smoke checks.

title: Create minimal DX-OS build system
description: BR001-R2: recreate DX-OS-owned .NET 10 SDK, CPM, feed, solution, project-boundary, ignore, and package metadata in the extracted repository; do not inherit Elsa build infrastructure.
acceptance_criteria: Pinned .NET 10 configuration restores/builds DXOS.slnx from the extracted repository using only approved packages/feeds, and executable architecture checks prove the intended DX-OS project graph contains no Elsa source reference.

title: Extract DX-OS from Elsa Core repository
description: BR001-R1: create a new DX-OS-owned repository from a reviewed inventory while preserving the Elsa checkout and Beads/OpenSpec state. No cleanup-in-place or Elsa history inheritance.
acceptance_criteria: Clean DX-OS checkout contains no Elsa source tree or Elsa Git history/remote and DXOS.slnx contains only intentional DX-OS projects.

title: DX-OS bootstrap remediation
description: Resolve the accepted NOT_READY findings from docs/audits/BOOTSTRAP-AUDIT-001.md under the authoritative OpenSpec change bootstrap-remediation-001. OpenSpec defines the contract; Beads tracks execution.
acceptance_criteria: A clean-clone follow-up audit returns READY and DX-OS no longer depends on the Elsa source checkout.

title: Enable DX-OS CI security and OSS compliance
description: BR001-R7: add DX-OS CI, pinned Gitleaks/Trivy/Syft/Grype gates with canaries and integrity checks, SBOM artifacts, and accurate OSS/license disclosures.
acceptance_criteria: Local and CI gates prove effective scanners, produce a resolved CycloneDX SBOM, scan it under policy, upload evidence, pin third-party actions/tools immutably, and keep notices aligned with actual deliverables.

title: Run DX-OS bootstrap follow-up audit
description: BR001-R8: clone the approved DX-OS remote into an empty directory and independently execute every READY gate without access to the Elsa checkout or untracked state.
acceptance_criteria: Audit report verifies every required tool and quality/runtime gate and returns READY before product feature implementation.

title: Configure DX-OS OpenSpec, ADRs, and agent governance
description: BR001-R6: establish DX-OS-owned OpenSpec, Beads mapping, ADRs, UTF-8 agent rules, durable task evidence, and docs/PROJECT_STATE.md after the test foundation is proven.
acceptance_criteria: Agents resolve DX-OS authority correctly; OpenSpec validates; ADRs and project state are durable and encoding-clean; walkthrough claims are evidence-backed.

title: Build meaningful DX-OS test foundation
description: BR001-R5: replace placeholder tests with xUnit v3 unit tests, ArchUnitNET rules, real PostgreSQL Testcontainers integration tests, and truthful E2E N/A evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Unit, architecture, PostgreSQL integration, and Elsa smoke tests exercise production behavior with meaningful assertions and report nonzero executed counts; empty E2E artifacts are removed and E2E is explicitly N/A.

title: BOOTSTRAP AUDIT 001
description: Audit Gemini bootstrap against DXOS constitution; verify Elsa coupling, architecture, tooling, quality gates, security/OSS, package management, and publish docs/audits/BOOTSTRAP-AUDIT-001.md. No business feature implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Audit report exists with requested sections and each claim is backed by repository inspection or executed verification; no business feature is implemented.
close_reason: Audit completed; evidence and verdict published in docs/audits/BOOTSTRAP-AUDIT-001.md. Remediation tracked under epic open_source-cab.
